description: This file is a makefile fragment for building Linux kernel modules within the OpenWrt build system. It defines variables, rules, and functions for kernel configuration, compilation, and module handling, including versioning, architecture detection, and module auto-loading.

methods.name: collect_module_symvers
methods.description: Collects and merges module version symbols from subdirectories into a single Module.symvers file.

methods.name: KernelPackage/hooks
methods.description: Defines hooks for post-processing during kernel module compilation, specifically to collect module symbol versions.

methods.name: KernelPackage/Defaults
methods.description: Sets default properties for kernel packages such as files, autoload, and module parameters.

methods.name: ModuleAutoLoad
methods.description: Automatically generates module load scripts and boot scripts based on module lists and parameters.

methods.name: KernelPackage/depends
methods.description: Defines dependencies for kernel packages based on kernel configuration.

methods.name: KernelPackage
methods.description: Main function to define a kernel module package with all associated properties, dependencies, and installation rules.

methods.name: version_filter
methods.description: Determines version filtering for package files based on metadata or filename.

methods.name: AutoLoad
methods.description: Generates auto-load configuration for modules with priority and boot flags.

methods.name: AutoProbe
methods.description: Generates auto-probe configuration for modules with boot flags.

methods.name: CompareKernelPatchVer
methods.description: Compares kernel patch versions for conditional logic based on version.
